= prepared-attributes(1)
:doctype: manpage
:name: Early
:empty:
:bold: pass:q[*Bold*]
:frozen: pass:a,q[*{name}*]
:quotes-first: pass:q,a[*{name}*]
:normal: pass:normal[*{name}* (C)]
:link: pass:m[https://example.org[Site]]
:term: pass:m[((Term))]
:anonymous: pass:m[footnote:[Anonymous body.]]
:note: pass:m[footnote:n[Named body.]]
:unused-term: pass:m[(((Unused))) ]
:unused-note: pass:m[footnote:u[Unused body.]]
:alias: {bold} / {frozen} / {anonymous}
:empty-before: pass:a,q[*{empty}*]
:empty-after: pass:q,a[*{empty}*]
:escaped: pass:a,q[*\{name}*]
:q-c: pass:q,c[*Escaped*]
:m-c: pass:m,c[https://example.org[Escaped site]]
:partial: prefix pass:q[*Literal*]
:acdc-index:

== NAME

prepared-attributes - formatted document attributes

== SYNOPSIS

*prepared-attributes*

== DESCRIPTION

:name: Late
:bold: pass:q[*Body*]
:body: pass:a,q[*{name}*]

Frozen: {frozen} / {quotes-first} / {normal} / {body}.

Alias: {alias} / {bold} / {anonymous} / {anonymous}.

Macros: {link} / {term} / {note} / footnote:n[].

Empty: {empty-before} / {empty-after}. Escaped: {escaped}.

Order: {q-c} / {m-c}. Partial: {partial}.

[cols="a,a"]
|===
|:name: Cell

Cell: {frozen} / {alias}.
|Other: {name} / {bold}.
|===

:bold!:

Unset: {bold} / {alias}.

[index]
== Index
